test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was able to attract the attention of the judges with her intellect and _______ demeanor
solution:
The correct answer is '**bewitching**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The word "**bewitching**" means charming or enchanting, which fits well with the description of her intellect and demeanor. 
 
• Options **2 (repugnant)**, **3 (revolting)**, and **4 (repellent)** have negative connotations and are inappropriate in the context. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"She was able to attract the attention of the judges with her intellect and **bewitching**__ demeanor."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 2: "repugnant"** is incorrect because it means distasteful or offensive, which doesn't align with the positive context of the sentence. 
 
• **Option 3: "revolting"** is incorrect because it means disgusting or repulsive, which is unsuitable here. 
 
• **Option 4: "repellent"** is incorrect because it refers to something that repels or pushes away, which conflicts with the idea of attracting attention.
